questions.prompt: Write a polite Japanese greeting for 'Good morning' using Romaji.
questions.explanation: Ohayou gozaimasu is the polite morning greeting.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese word for 'water' using Romaji.
Write the Japanese verb 'to eat' using Romaji.
Translate 'I am a student' using Romaji. A natural topic-based answer is expected.
questions.explanation: Watashi wa gakusei desu follows topic + description + desu.

questions.prompt: Translate 'I drink water' using Romaji and include the object particle.
questions.explanation: O marks mizu as the direct object of nomimasu.

questions.prompt: Write the Romaji words for 'today, tomorrow, yesterday' in that order.
questions.explanation: Kyou, ashita, kinou mean today, tomorrow, yesterday.

questions.prompt: Translate 'I want to eat sushi' using Romaji.
questions.explanation: The verb stem tabe- plus tai expresses wanting to eat.

questions.prompt: Translate 'There is a cat' using Romaji.
questions.explanation: Iru/imasu is used for living things.

questions.prompt: Translate 'I go to the library today' using Romaji.
acceptedAnswers: watashi wa kyou toshokan ni ikimasu
questions.explanation: Ni marks the destination, and ikimasu means go.

questions.prompt: Explain this Romaji sentence in English: Ashita kouen de tomodachi to hanashimasu.
acceptedAnswers: tomorrow i will talk with a friend at the park
i will talk with my friend at the park tomorrow
tomorrow i talk with a friend at the park
questions.explanation: It means talking with a friend at the park tomorrow.
